images.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram.
Asset type: Chinese educational illustration accompanying a detailed explanation of the real Pico agent memory implementation.
Style: polished light editorial infographic, off-white background, charcoal large sans-serif Chinese typography, sky-blue / amber / jade accents, flat geometric document and database icons, restrained line illustrations, ample whitespace, landscape 3:2 composition. No photos, no robot, brain, circuitry, neon, watermark or unrelated branding. All Simplified Chinese must be legible, spelled exactly, large enough for reading. Arrows must communicate the exact relationships. Do not invent implementation features.
Primary request: Show three complementary types of memory as three equally sized document cards, with their separate responsibilities and persistence boundaries.
Title (exact): "Pico 的三层记忆"
Subtitle (exact): "保存过程 · 接续任务 · 跨会话复用"
Composition: top two-thirds three side-by-side cards; bottom third two storage zones. First and second cards connect separately down to the same blue storage zone. Third card connects down to the separate green user storage zone. Do not draw arrows turning a checkpoint summary directly into long-term memory.
Card 1 blue: heading "会话历史", labels "对话与工具结果", "恢复与回读", document icon showing message lines.
Card 2 amber: heading "压缩交接", labels "目标、进度、约束、证据", "对话太长后继续任务", folded document and bookmark icon.
Card 3 green: heading "长期记忆", labels "偏好、背景、知识、笔记", "新会话也能复用", small structured index cards.
Storage zone under cards 1-2 exact text: "工作区 pico.sqlite"; secondary exact text "原始事件 + checkpoint"
Storage zone under card 3 exact text: "用户级 memory.sqlite"; show two scope chips "全局" and "当前工作区".
Footer exact text: "会话与长期记忆，生命周期独立"
Ensure this is a comparison diagram, not a numbered temporal sequence. Keep all labels short and clear.

Use case: infographic-diagram.
Asset type: Chinese educational illustration accompanying a detailed explanation of the real Pico agent memory implementation.
Style: polished light editorial infographic, off-white background, charcoal large sans-serif Chinese typography, sky-blue / amber / jade accents, flat geometric document and database icons, restrained line illustrations, ample whitespace, landscape 3:2 composition. No photos, no robot, brain, circuitry, neon, watermark or unrelated branding. All Simplified Chinese must be legible, spelled exactly, large enough for reading. Arrows must communicate the exact relationships. Do not invent implementation features.
Primary request: Show evidence-based long-term-memory writing and the resulting structured Item, illustrated with a real example. Main visual is a left-to-right workflow with clear local-vs-model distinction; beneath it a large memory-card specimen.
Title (exact): "一条长期记忆，怎样保存下来"
Top-left speech bubble exact text: "这个项目统一使用 pnpm"
Main workflow five rounded stages, with arrows in this exact order:
1 "用户证据" (blue)
2 "模型提取" (amber)
3 "程序校验" (blue)
4 "独立规范化" (amber)
5 "事务保存" (green database, exact filename "memory.sqlite")
Under stage 3 a compact exact label "来源与引文"; under stage 4 exact label "再次校验后入库".
On the left beside the workflow, three small entry chips with exact text "正常回合完成" / "压缩 checkpoint" / "明确要求记住"; they point into the user-evidence workflow, not straight to storage. Add one separate small path beneath from exact label "手动添加与更正" directly to the database, with exact label "本地校验", bypassing the two model stages.
The large specimen card below has heading "结构化 Item". Render these five rows exactly:
"正文：该项目统一使用 pnpm"
"类型：knowledge"
"范围：workspace"
"关键词：pnpm"
"来源：原始用户事件"
At bottom of card show three small chips "版本" "内容 hash" "事件时间".
Footer exact text: "提交条目、关键词、来源与处理进度"
Accuracy constraints: This card is an illustrative example, not a real saved user memory. Do not imply all user messages become memories or that assistant-generated claims are user evidence. Do not add vector/embedding icons. Do not label explicit remember as background-only.

Use case: infographic-diagram.
Asset type: Chinese educational illustration accompanying a detailed explanation of the real Pico agent memory implementation.
Style: polished light editorial infographic, off-white background, charcoal large sans-serif Chinese typography, sky-blue / amber / jade accents, flat geometric document and database icons, restrained line illustrations, ample whitespace, landscape 3:2 composition. No photos, no robot, brain, circuitry, neon, watermark or unrelated branding. All Simplified Chinese must be legible, spelled exactly, large enough for reading. Arrows must communicate the exact relationships. Do not invent implementation features.
Primary request: Explain budgeted lexical recall and separate operational tracking, making clear memory storage capacity differs from per-request retrieval limits.
Title (exact): "记忆怎样进入模型请求"
Top flow horizontally: speech bubble "项目用什么包管理器？" -> database "memory.sqlite" -> stage "本地检索" -> stage "筛选与排序".
Small labels under local retrieval: "关键词" / "正文" / "中文补充匹配"; small labels under selection "范围" / "归档状态" / "相关性".
Then two large parallel branches, both leading to the same destination "模型请求":
Blue branch "自动召回", prominent exact text "最多 3 条 · 320 tokens".
Green branch "主动 memory_search", prominent exact text "最多 10 条 · 5120 tokens", secondary exact text "单条最多 480 tokens".
Between branch outputs and model request put a small exact badge "历史参考 · 无指令权限".
Lower third is a separate amber observation strip with heading "召回追踪". Four checkpoints with small dotted connectors, exact labels in reading order:
"本地选择" -> "请求装配核对" -> "响应事实" -> "运行详情".
Under the observation strip two compact explanatory labels exactly "条目 ID / 版本 / hash" and "重复 / 条数 / 预算淘汰".
Final bottom caption exact text: "单次召回上限，不是记忆库容量"
Accuracy constraints: Local retrieval uses no vector service and no extra retrieval model. Operational trace does not save memory body snapshots. Showing references in a request or observing a response does not prove correct model use. Keep numeric budgets accurate and labels very readable.
